recognize_zh: 這是一張組合圖：A、B 抹片中有母細胞、嗜鹼性球及含深色粗顆粒的異常嗜酸性球；C 核型圖以箭頭標出 9、22 號與 16 號染色體異常；D-F 的 FISH 分別顯示 BCR-ABL1 融合訊號與 CBFB 斷裂分離訊號，連嗜中性球也帶有兩者。
features: Panels A-B: blasts with fine chromatin admixed with maturing granulocytes
Abnormal eosinophils with coarse dark basophilic-appearing granules and increased basophils (arrows)
Panel C: G-banded karyotype with arrows marking abnormal chromosomes 9, 22, and 16, consistent with t(9;22) and inv(16)
Panel D: metaphase FISH showing BCR::ABL1 fusion signals
Panel E: CBFB break-apart probe showing split signals
Panel F: interphase FISH demonstrating both BCR::ABL1 fusion and CBFB rearrangement in neutrophils
describe_en: This composite figure shows marrow/blood smears (A, B) with increased blasts, basophils, and abnormal eosinophils containing coarse dark granules. The G-banded karyotype (C) demonstrates rearrangements involving chromosomes 9 and 22 together with an inversion of chromosome 16, and metaphase FISH confirms a BCR::ABL1 fusion (D) and CBFB rearrangement (E). Interphase FISH shows both abnormalities within mature neutrophils (F), indicating that they coexist in the same clone with myeloid maturation. The findings describe acute myeloid leukemia with coexistent t(9;22)(q34;q11.2) and inv(16)(p13.1q22); the differential with myeloid blast phase of CML requires clinical history.

ddx.dx: Chronic myeloid leukemia, myeloid blast phase with inv(16) as additional abnormality
ddx.vs: Blast phase of CML is supported by a preceding chronic phase or marked basophilia and splenomegaly, and cannot be separated from de novo AML by morphology alone.
De novo AML with BCR::ABL1 lacks the CBFB::MYH11 rearrangement and typically has no prior CML history or marked basophilia.

ddx.dx: AML with inv(16); CBFB::MYH11 without BCR::ABL1
ddx.vs: Morphology is identical, but FISH/karyotype lack the BCR::ABL1 fusion, which carries different therapy (TKI) implications.
